query: Периодически выбирай новые записи из PostgreSQL public.orders и сохраняй их в JSON-файл orders_export.json.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: orders_export_pipeline
  name: Orders Export to JSON
  description: Periodically select new records from PostgreSQL public.orders and save
    to orders_export.json
triggers:
- id: schedule_trigger
  type: schedule
  condition: every 5 minutes
sources:
- id: source_postgres_orders
  name: PostgreSQL Orders Table
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: public.orders
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{DB_HOST}}'
      port: '{{DB_PORT}}'
      database: '{{DATABASE_NAME}}'
      username: '{{DB_USERNAME}}'
      password: '{{DB_PASSWORD}}'
processing_elements:
- id: process_new_records
  name: Select New Records
  operation: Filter
  config:
    condition: '{{NEW_RECORDS_CONDITION}}'
sinks:
- id: sink_json_file
  name: JSON File Sink
  type: File
  location: orders_export.json
processed_data:
- id: orders_json
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_postgres_orders
  to_id: process_new_records
  data_ref: orders_json
- from_id: process_new_records
  to_id: sink_json_file
  data_ref: orders_json
